comparator.name: Bachelor Fiscaal Recht
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted 2026–2027 regulations cover students entering from September 2026. The standard Dutch-taught, full-time LLB has 29 compulsory components, with 60 EC per year and 180 EC in total. The first year is shared with Law. Article 10 sets the credit values, including 6 EC for second-year Professional Skills and 10 EC for the third-year individual thesis. The standard pathway has no open electives. Under Article 17 the 18 EC MaRBLe project can replace the 10 EC thesis only when an individual project satisfies the thesis requirements; the other 8 EC are extra. Article 21 requires introductory private law for semester 4 and civil procedure, introductory criminal law for advanced criminal law, introductory administrative law for administrative procedure, and introductory tax law for the three named advanced personal and corporate tax courses. Article 21 uses MET2205 for the civil procedure course named PRI3205 in Article 10. The 2026 catalogue adds completed introductory foundations, criminal law and administrative law to the semester 5 entry conditions alongside private law; the standard pathway contains all four in year 1. The 2026 thesis entry requires 60 EC completed and a research proposal before supervision. Article 13 makes attendance dependent on the assessment design. The first-year study advice threshold is 40 EC, subject to the rules on personal circumstances.

UCR offers comparative legal analysis, public economics, accounting and policy research. Public Economics examines taxation, redistribution and welfare. Constitutional and EU law teach public authority, legal remedies and free movement, and Transnational Business Law examines cross-border contracts and trade. Those contributions cover parts of the context for taxation. audience.programmeDescription: Maastricht’s Dutch-taught Tax Law degree covers tax rules for individuals and businesses in the Netherlands and across borders. Students interpret legislation, work through cases and write an individual legal research paper. The first year is shared with the Law bachelor.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR covers taxation and redistribution in Public Economics and offers complementary courses in comparative law and accounting. Maastricht’s degree goes further into applying tax legislation, handling tax disputes and researching tax law.

curriculum.limitation: The standard programme has 180 EC of required coursework and an individual thesis within that total. First-year study advice generally requires 40 EC.

componentNotes.y2-05: Before starting semester 4, students must pass Introduction to Private Law.
componentNotes.y2-10: Professional skills run across the second year for a total of 6 EC.
componentNotes.y3-01: Requires Introduction to Criminal Law and Criminal Procedure.
componentNotes.y3-03: Students complete the first-year introductions to private, administrative and criminal law and foundations of law before this course.
componentNotes.y3-09: The individually assessed thesis carries 10 EC. Registration requires 60 EC already earned. Students submit a research proposal before receiving supervision.
